name: Serra de Daró (Spain)
description: Red field with a white fess indented below forming yellow triangles, above a white and blue wavy fess.
history: The flag was approved on 10 March 2002 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3111 of 31 March 2002; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with a white fess 1/6 of the height whose lower edge is indented forming six yellow triangles, a canting sign (serra, saw).

features.role: fess 1/6 of the height with its lower edge indented into six yellow triangles
six triangles below the white fess
